::: {#sol-dropout-final}

`r if (py$drop_final_val < py$final_row[["val"]]) "Yes" else "No"`.
After 300 [epochs](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/gradient-descent.html#def-epoch) its validation loss is `r sprintf("%.3f", py$drop_final_val)`,
against `r sprintf("%.3f", py$final_row[["val"]])` without [dropout](#def-dropout).
So on these digits dropout does not replace [early stopping](#def-early-stopping):
the validation loss still `r if (py$drop_final_val > py$drop_best_val) "rises" else "does not rise"` after its lowest point.

:::
